groupForm.title: Edit group

groupForm.slugHelp: Used to address this group in the API and scripts (e.g. checkGroupSlug in incident payloads). Changing it breaks any existing references.
groupForm.slugInvalid: Slug must start with a lowercase letter, be 3-40 characters, and contain only lowercase letters, digits, or hyphens.
groupForm.slugTaken: A check group with this slug already exists in this organization.
groupForm.descriptionPlaceholder: What is this group of checks for?
groupForm.escalationDescription: Member checks inherit this policy unless they set their own.

addCheckToGroup: Add a check to this group
noUngroupedChecks: No ungrouped checks match your search

toast.groupDeleted: Group deleted. Checks have been ungrouped.

form.statusCodeInvalid: Not a valid status code or wildcard (e.g. 200, 4XX)
form.dnsExpectedIpsHint: The check fails unless every listed IP is present in the resolved answers. Leave empty to only require a successful resolution.
form.dnsExpectedValuesHint: One value per line, matched exactly against the resolved records (MX as "priority host", names without a trailing dot). The check fails unless every listed value is present. Leave empty to only require a successful resolution.
form.flappingHelp: De-duplicate short blips and require longer stability before resolving a check that keeps flapping.
form.confirmationPeriodHelp: Wait this long after the first failure before opening an incident. 0 = open immediately.
form.recoveryPeriodHelp: Wait this long after the first success before resolving the incident. Any failure inside the window resets the clock.
form.regionsHint: Each selected region runs the check every {{period}}.
form.regionsHintSpread: Each selected region runs the check every {{period}}, staggered {{spread}} apart.
form.regionSpreadHelp: Overrides how far apart regions are staggered. Leave empty to keep automatic spreading.
form.regionSpreadRangeError: Region spread must be at least 0 and less than the check period ({{period}}).
form.periodImmediateOpen: Opens an incident immediately on the first failure.
form.periodImmediateResolve: Resolves the incident immediately on the first success.
form.reopenCooldownHelp: A relapse inside this window reattaches to the previous incident instead of paging again.
form.reopenCooldownOff: off — always opens a new incident
form.flappingWindowHelp: Outages within this window escalate the required recovery time. 0 = off.
form.flapBackoffFactorHelp: Each flap multiplies the required recovery by this. 1 = off.
form.maxRecoveryMultiplierHelp: Required recovery never exceeds this × the base recovery period.
form.tracerouteOnFailureHelp: When this check goes down because the target could not be REACHED (connect timeout, refusal, ICMP loss, TLS handshake stall), capture an MTR-style path trace and attach it to the incident. Application-level failures such as HTTP 5xx, a keyword mismatch or an expiring certificate never trigger one — the server answered, so the path is fine.
form.identityDescription: What to monitor, and how to find it later
form.timeoutRangeError: Timeout must be between 1 and 30 seconds
form.notificationsDescription: Who gets paged when this check fails
form.warningDaysHelp: Amber warning (no page) at or below this. Must be ≥ Critical.
form.name: Name
form.nameAutoGeneratedHint: If not provided, a name will be auto-generated
form.schedulingDescription: How often the check runs, and from where
form.heartbeatIntervalHint: Check will be marked as down if no heartbeat is received within this interval
form.emailIntervalHint: Check will be marked as down if no email is received within this interval
form.privateRegionTitle: Runs on your own deported agents
form.selectRegionsHint: Select the regions where this check should run
form.labelsHint: Optional key/value tags for grouping and filtering.
form.timeoutHint: Seconds a single probe may run (1–30). Empty uses the default of 15 seconds.
form.notifyViaCreateHelp: to be paged when this check fails.
form.notifyViaSelectedHelp: Channels selected here are notified on incident events.
form.slugMustNotBeUuid: Slug must not be a UUID
form.slugMinLength: Slug must be at least 3 characters
form.slugMaxLength: Slug must be at most 100 characters
form.slugMustStartLowercase: Slug must start with a lowercase letter
form.slugInvalidChars: Slug must contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens
form.regionsIpv6Hint: This check is pinned to IPv6. Regions whose live workers report IPv6 egress are listed first — the others stay selectable, and a region marked “IPv6 unknown” has simply not reported yet.

freebox.discoverDescription: Pick a host visible to your Freebox to pre-fill an ICMP check.
freebox.error: Could not load hosts from the Freebox.
freebox.noHosts: No hosts visible on this Freebox.

freeboxLine.connectionUidHelp: Pick a paired Freebox connection. If you have none, pair one in Channels.
freeboxLine.noConnections: No paired Freebox connections. Pair one to start.
freeboxLine.thresholdsHelp: Solidping reports the check as down if any configured threshold is crossed. Leave a field at 0 to skip that threshold.

dnsbl.targetHelp: IPv4 address or hostname to check against the blocklists.
dnsbl.blocklistsHelp: Optional. One DNS blocklist zone per line (or comma-separated). Leave empty to use the defaults (Spamhaus, SpamCop, Barracuda, UCEPROTECT).
dnsbl.nameserverHelp: Optional host:port of a recursive resolver. Public resolvers (8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1) are blocked by Spamhaus, so use a local resolver if needed.
dnsbl.title: Blocklist status
dnsbl.description: How the target resolved against each DNS blocklist zone.

sip.domainHelp: Optional. SIP domain/realm for the address of record. Defaults to the host.
sip.passwordEncrypted: (encrypted — enter a new value to replace)
sip.expectStatusHelp: Optional. Comma-separated SIP status codes that count as Up (e.g. 200 or 200,405). Leave empty to accept any valid SIP response.

resultDetail.viewAll: View all results for this check

fallback.title: The exact result you requested is no longer stored.
fallback.rolledUpToHour: It was rolled up into this hour aggregation ({{start}}–{{end}}) covering its timestamp ({{ts}}).
fallback.rolledUpToDay: It was rolled up into this day aggregation ({{start}}–{{end}}) covering its timestamp ({{ts}}).
fallback.rolledUpToMonth: It was rolled up into this month aggregation ({{start}}–{{end}}) covering its timestamp ({{ts}}).
fallback.originalUid: The original UID {{uid}} was deleted as part of automatic aggregation.

resultDetail.notFound: Result not found — it may have been deleted as part of automatic aggregation, and we couldn't find an aggregation covering its timestamp.

evaluation.title: Scheduler evaluation
evaluation.explainerHeartbeat: This row was written by the {{region}} checks worker when it evaluated the check's schedule. It is not a heartbeat — nothing called in at this time.
evaluation.explainerEmail: This row was written by the {{region}} checks worker when it evaluated the check's schedule. It is not an email — no email arrived at this time.
evaluation.explainerNoRegion: This row was written by a checks worker when it evaluated the check's schedule. It is not a heartbeat — nothing called in at this time.
evaluation.explainerEmailNoRegion: This row was written by a checks worker when it evaluated the check's schedule. It is not an email — no email arrived at this time.

chart.title: Response Times
chart.zoomHint: Drag across the chart to zoom into a time range
chart.zoomHintReset: Zoomed in — drag to refine, or double-click to reset
chart.rawUnavailable: Latest points unavailable — showing aggregated data only

detail.liveUnavailableTooltip: Live updates are unavailable for this check ({{title}}) — falling back to polling.

dutyCycle.title: This check occupies a monitoring slot {{duty}}% of the time
dutyCycle.description: Each run takes about {{cost}} with a period of {{period}}, so this check keeps a runner busy {{duty}}% of the time. Increase its period to free monitoring capacity.

needsReseal.title: Credentials need re-sealing for this private location
needsReseal.description: This check runs in a private location and its stored credentials are sealed to a different set of agents than the ones currently active — an agent was enrolled or revoked since they were saved, so agents can't decrypt them and the check will fail. SolidPing can't re-seal them itself (it can't read them either): re-enter and save the credentials to fix this.

results.evaluationTooltip: Written by the scheduler when it evaluated the check. Not a heartbeat.

detail.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this check? This action cannot be undone.

heartbeat.title: Heartbeat Endpoint
heartbeat.callerNote: Each ping's User-Agent, source IP, and HTTP method are recorded and shown on that ping's result detail page.
heartbeat.regenerateDescription: This immediately invalidates the current ping URL — anything still sending to it will start failing right away. Update your heartbeat sender with the new URL as soon as you confirm.

push.title: Embedded devices (TCP/UDP)
push.description: Microcontrollers and cellular modems can send one line per beat over raw TCP or UDP, with no TLS stack. Use SP1 while you get started, then move to the signed SP2 form.
push.annotationHint: Append an optional annotation: a status word and key=value fields, e.g. "started volts=3.71 rssi=-67". Numeric values are charted as metrics.
push.requireHmacHint: Reject the plaintext SP1 form on TCP and UDP. Only the signed SP2 form and the HTTPS endpoint above are accepted. Does not affect the HTTPS endpoint.
push.rotateNudge: This check has accepted plaintext beats, so its token may already have been seen on the wire — and that token is also the signing key. Regenerate it now.
push.hmacFailed: Failed to update the signature requirement
push.sketchDocsHint: For a ready-to-flash signed (SP2) sender, see the Arduino / ESP sketch in the Embedded devices docs.

email.title: Email Endpoint
email.notConfigured: Email inbox not configured. The check is created but cannot receive pings until an administrator configures the shared inbox.

help.intro: To report a failure or non-default status, use any of:
help.subject: Subject prefix: start the subject with [DOWN], [ERROR], or [RUNNING].
help.priority: Resolution priority: plus-address > header > subject > default up.

jsonAssertionsDescription: Validate fields in the JSON response body against a JSONPath expression.
secretHeadersDescription: Header values stored encrypted — use for API keys and Bearer tokens.

scheduling.title: Check scheduling
scheduling.subtitle: See where your per-minute execution demand comes from, and stretch or disable checks until it fits your plan.
scheduling.proposalSummary_one: Proposed {{count}} new period: {{before}} → {{after}} executions/min against a cap of {{limit}}.
scheduling.proposalSummary_other: Proposed {{count}} new periods: {{before}} → {{after}} executions/min against a cap of {{limit}}.
scheduling.rebalanceExhausted: Every check is already at its longest allowed period and the demand still exceeds the cap. Disable some checks, or upgrade your plan.
scheduling.passiveNote_one: {{count}} passive check (heartbeat or email) is not listed: it is triggered by an inbound signal, so it never consumes execution budget.
scheduling.passiveNote_other: {{count}} passive checks (heartbeat or email) are not listed: they are triggered by an inbound signal, so they never consume execution budget.

meter.label: Executions per minute
meter.hint: Each selected region runs the check at the full period, so a check in three regions costs three times as much.
meter.overHint: Your organization is over its cap — some check executions are being skipped.
meter.unlimitedHint: Your plan sets no per-minute execution cap.

empty.title: No active checks
empty.hint: Only active checks consume execution budget — create one to see it here.

toast.failed: Could not apply the schedule changes.

grpc.tlsSkipVerifyWarning: Certificate errors will be ignored — the check will report up even for an invalid, expired, or self-signed certificate.
grpc.metadataDescription: Sent with every health check RPC. Stored in plain text and searchable — use it for routing or tenant headers.
grpc.secretMetadataDescription: Metadata values stored encrypted — use for authorization bearers and API keys.
grpc.serviceNameHelp: Leave empty to check overall server health

docker.dockerHostHelp: Default: unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Use tcp://host:port for remote Docker daemons.
docker.restartLoopHelp: Flag a running container as crash-looping when it has restarted at least N times and (re)started within the recency window. Leave Min Restarts empty (or 0) to disable. A detected loop reports a Warning (amber) — it counts as up and does not page.
docker.restartLoopDescription: A running container that restarts repeatedly within the recency window is flagged as a suspected crash-loop (Warning).

escalation.silentNote: This policy has no steps — this check will never page anyone.
escalation.help: Who gets paged, in order, when this check fails.

http.followRedirectsOffHelp: The check will evaluate the first response (e.g. a 3XX) instead of following it to its destination.
http.captureFailingResponseHelp: When this check fails, the response it received (status line, headers with sensitive values redacted, and up to 16 KB of the body) is kept on the incident it opens. Response bodies can contain personal data — the capture is visible to your team only and never appears on a status page.

ipVersion.label: IP version (optional)
ipVersion.tunneledHelp: Not available on a tunneled check: the SSH bastion resolves the hostname and dials it, so the address family is the tunnel's to choose, not this check's.
ipVersion.autoHelp: Auto keeps today's behaviour — one address, whichever the target resolves to first. Pin a family to actually verify it: an IPv4 check never proves the target is reachable over IPv6, so a dual-stack host with a broken AAAA path still reports up. To watch both, create two checks.

mail.sendProbeEmailHelp: Submits a system-generated email through this server on every check, addressed to a paired email check's address, to verify the full delivery path (not just the handshake). The email check's period is the delivery deadline — size it to this check's interval plus the worst acceptable delivery time (greylisting can add minutes).
mail.emailInboxNotConfigured: Email inbox not configured. Ask your administrator to set it up under Server → Email Inbox.
mail.noEmailChecksYet: No email checks in this organization yet. Create one first, then come back to pair it here.
mail.probeEmailAddressedTo: Probe emails will be addressed to {{address}}.
mail.sendModeDeliveryDescription: This email was attributed to a send-mode SMTP check's probe.

misc.offsetWarningHelp: Amber (no page) when |offset| exceeds this. Must be ≤ Critical.
misc.maxStratumHelp: Down when the server's stratum exceeds this (1–15).
misc.requireNlaHelp: Down when the server does not select CredSSP — catches NLA silently disabled by policy.
misc.rdpCertCriticalHelp: Down (pages) when the certificate expires in at most this many days.
misc.rdpCertWarningHelp: Amber warning (no page). Must be ≥ Critical.
misc.rdpPreAuthHelp: Pre-auth handshake only — no credentials are sent. Workers need network access to the RDP host (typically internal).
misc.scriptHelp: JavaScript script that returns an object with status ("up", "down", or "error"), optional metrics, and optional output.
misc.sleepSyntheticHelp: Synthetic checker — sleeps for the configured duration and performs no network I/O. Useful for testing scheduler/load behavior, not a real availability probe.
misc.jitterHelp: ± random variation applied to the sleep duration. Must be less than the sleep duration itself.
misc.heartbeatHelp: No additional configuration needed. A heartbeat URL will be generated after creation.
misc.emailGeneratedHelp: An email address will be generated for this check. Send any email to that address to report a successful run. Use plus-addressing (token+down@…) or [DOWN] in the subject to report failure.

network.fingerprintHelpPrefix: Verifies the server's identity on every check, and is required to use this check as a
network.fingerprintHelpSuffix: bastion for other checks. Get it with
network.privateKeyEncrypted: (encrypted — enter a new key to replace)
network.passwordOverridesPrivateKey: If both a password and a private key are set, the password is used.

prometheus.modePromql: PromQL query against a Prometheus server
prometheus.promqlQueryHelp: Instant query. Scalar and instant-vector results are supported; a range (matrix) result is rejected. This is also where rates belong — the check does no client-side rate computation.
prometheus.metricHelp: Histograms and summaries are addressed through their flattened series: _sum, _count, _bucket (with an le label) or a quantile label.
prometheus.labelsHelp: The series must carry every pair listed here. Extra labels on the series are fine.
prometheus.thresholdHelp: Critical goes Down and pages; Warning is amber, counts as up and never pages. Set at least one — a warning-only check is valid. 0 is a real threshold. = and ≠ take a critical threshold only.
prometheus.matchSingle: Single — error if more than one matches
prometheus.matchHelp: An ambiguous selector is reported rather than resolved by guessing.
prometheus.requestHeadersHelp: For endpoints behind bearer or basic auth.

tunnel.label: Run through SSH tunnel (optional)
tunnel.createSshCheck: Create an SSH check for your bastion
tunnel.createSshCheckWarning: — this opens a new form, so any unsaved changes here are lost.
tunnel.help: Dial this check's target through an SSH check's connection, to reach services behind a bastion. The hostname is resolved by the bastion, so private names work. Tunnel setup time is reported separately as tunnel_setup_ms and excluded from the check's response time.

web.waitSelectorHelp: CSS selector to wait for before checking. Leave empty to wait for body.
web.keywordHelp: Text to search for in the rendered page content.
web.captureScreenshotHelp: Keeps a PNG of the page on the incident this check opens or reopens. Taken just after the failure is detected, from the probing region — evidence, not the failing frame itself. Off by default.

ssl.chainDescription: Every presented certificate. The status is driven by the soonest to expire.
ssl.subject: Subject
